events.title: 2 S&P 500 Stocks to Target This Week and 1 We Find Risky
events.body: The S&P 500 (^GSPC) is home to the biggest and most well-known companies in the market, making it a go-to index for investors seeking stability. But not all large-cap stocks are created equal - some are struggling with slowing growth, declining margins, or increased competition.

events.title: New Strong Sell Stocks for May 12th

events.title: Eaton's Q1 Earnings and Revenues Surpass Estimates, Guidance Raised
events.body: ETN tops Q1 estimates as revenues jump 17% and EPS rises 3%; it has lifted 2026 adjusted EPS guidance and sees 9-11% organic growth.
